answers.core: It can be a plugin – https://github.com/Herbherth/GDScript-Quality-of-Life already is – but I don't see why this can't be part of the editor as every GDscript coder will experience this minor inconvenience a thousand times over in their project.
answers.workaround: You can manually remove the indentation after typing `return`, `break` or `continue`, of course.

title: Auto remove one indentation after `return`, `break` and `continue`
